encode_text_as_pieces: encode input text files into SentencePiece pieces using a specified SentencePiece model
encode_text_as_ids: encode input text files into SentencePiece token IDs using a specified SentencePiece model
filter_by_token_length: filter encoded lines by minimum and maximum token length thresholds
encode_multiple_files: encode multiple input files in parallel and write results to corresponding output files
encode_stdin_to_stdout: encode text from stdin to stdout using a SentencePiece model with piece or id format
